positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Lead Software Engineer and Product Owner for mission critical software component
* Deriving and allocating customer requirements into detailed software design and implementation
* Built the product's software architecture via activity, sequence, and class diagrams that satisfy software requirements using Cameo Systems Modeler
▪ Implemented the software product's API and backend capabilities using C++

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked on the development of the Enduring Shield launcher software
* Designed and improved on existing algorithms based on extra factors

* Implemented fault injection capabilities in simulators to assess and reduce risk
